persona_assignment_rationale: The persona is a 22-year-old white female living in urban New York, working in retail, highly progressive and a regular news consumer. Variables chosen reflect race (white), sex (female), urban residence (large city), political views (liberal as proxy for highly progressive), occupation sector (retail trade), news consumption frequency (once a day as regular news consumer), and survey year (2024). Age is not directly available as a variable, so it is omitted.
